card.name: Leading digit of thousand-scale numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (or 2) that begins a number in the thousands, such as 1,000 or 1,400, mostly in mg dose amounts. It also fires on 'two' before 'thousand years' and on thousands-scale citation or coordinate numbers.

modes.label: Thousand-range doses
modes.description: The first digit of a dose of about 1,000 to 1,800 mg.
modes.example: The maximum oral doses of lapatinib that have been administered in clinical trials are <<1>>,800 mg once daily.

modes.label: Other thousands numbers
modes.description: A leading digit or the word two before thousand in non-dose text such as history or page numbers.
modes.example: central figure in the civilized world for nearly<< two>> thousand years

card.plain: It marks the start of a number in the thousands, often a milligram dose like 1,000 or 1,400.
